description: This file defines the IntegrationAttributeSyncService class, including methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting integration attribute sync configurations, along with related error classes and validation logic.

classes.name: DuplicateAttributeWithinSyncError
classes.description: Error thrown when an attribute is mapped more than once within the same sync.

classes.name: DuplicateAttributeAcrossSyncsError
classes.description: Error thrown when an attribute is mapped in more than one sync.

classes.name: UnauthorizedAttributeError
classes.description: Error thrown when attributes do not belong to the organization.

classes.name: CredentialNotFoundError
classes.description: Error thrown when a credential cannot be found.

classes.name: IntegrationAttributeSyncService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to manage integration attribute sync configurations, including validation and CRUD operations.

methods.name: extractTeamIdsFromRule
methods.description: Extracts team IDs from a given attribute sync rule.

methods.name: validateTeamsBelongToOrg
methods.description: Validates that specified team IDs belong to the given organization.

methods.name: validateWithinSyncUniqueness
methods.description: Ensures attribute mappings are unique within a sync.

methods.name: validateCrossSyncUniqueness
methods.description: Ensures attribute mappings are unique across different syncs within an organization.

methods.name: validateAttributeOwnership
methods.description: Checks that attributes belong to the organization.

methods.name: getEnabledAppCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves enabled app credentials for an organization.

methods.name: getAllIntegrationAttributeSyncs
methods.description: Fetches all attribute sync configurations for an organization.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute sync configuration by ID.

methods.name: createAttributeSync
methods.description: Creates a new attribute sync configuration after validation.

methods.name: updateIncludeRulesAndMappings
methods.description: Updates sync rules and field mappings for an existing configuration.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes an attribute sync configuration by ID.

methods.name: getAllByCredentialId
methods.description: Retrieves all sync configurations associated with a credential ID.
